horoscope: With the Moon in the hidden sector of your solar chart today, dear Aries, you are a little more retiring than usual. Still, transits support feeling pleasantly connected with someone or focusing on a relationship in a comfortable way. It's also a good time to tie up loose ends, reflect, catch up on rest, and heal. You stand to gain some wonderful insight into a love relationship today, as the atmosphere is ripe for intimacy. Or you might admit to feelings you've been avoiding, if only to yourself. You're in a wonderful position for strategizing both along practical and personal lines, and perhaps even combining the two creatively. Schedules may not be reliable early today, however.

Today, you're likely to find it more straightforward than usual to quench your thirst for ambitious undertakings while also getting in some much-needed relaxation or mental release, dear Taurus. You may have more self-discipline than usual, and because tomorrow's energies can be quite the opposite, you might want to take advantage of this now. Still, you appreciate your relationships, which seem to be more comfortable and accepting than they have been. You're in a great place to forgive, forget, or simply enjoy the finer qualities of someone in your life without paying too much or any attention to the less palatable ones. Seeing eye-to-eye on money, sharing, and ownership matters may not be quite so easy or natural, however. In fact, there can be a lot of back and forth before you're ready to agree. Nevertheless, it's a good exercise in understanding, and you may very well end up with better, more refined plans.

The Moon has made it to the top of your solar chart, dear Gemini, which can put you in a rather earnest or responsible frame of mind. Career matters, life-path plans, responsibilities, and long-term goals come into stronger focus at this time of the lunar month. You're also getting noticed, and it's what you do or what you've done that gets the most attention now. As a result, you're checking in with the rules or your own goals, which can motivate you to push a little more, step up your game, and do your best. Today is also solid for enjoying your connections. Still, the Moon in Pisces fairly demands some respite from dull routines, and you can enjoy doing things just a little differently to keep things fresh.

You're in a good position for connecting with  people and for creative ventures today, dear Cancer. Venus in your creative and romantic sector harmonizes with the Moon, and the Moon spends the day in your adventure sector, inspiring you to reach new heights, dream, and aspire. This can be a day when you're seeking some extra emotional stimulation. You're bound to shake things up so that life doesn't become dull. The past couple of days have been valuable for much-needed introspection, but now you're eager to see what's to come. You may be seeking some form of escape from the regular. There is more spontaneity in your approach to the day. People tend to let you do your thing, and this does everything to improve your mood.

Today is potentially quite fortunate for family matters, domestic activities, and private matters, dear Leo. You are more perceptive than usual, as you can quickly cut through the fluff to the true motivations or bottom line. You might thoroughly enjoy a deeper connection with a special project or relationship. It can be a particularly creative day for family life or home matters, as Venus in the sector of your solar chart that rules these things harmonizes with the Moon in your intimacy sector. You may find yourself in the position to play detective, and this can be quite welcome and pleasant! It can be a time of valuable -- or at the very least, enjoyable -- investigating, researching, and analyzing. You gravitate towards projects, relationships, and situations that pull you in and demand your full attention.

The Moon is now in your partnership sector, dear Virgo, and your social instincts are strong. This is a good day for new ideas and enthusiasm for a person or project. It's a wonderful day for communicating, connecting, and enjoying learning with Venus in your communications sector in harmony with the Moon. It's a time of the lunar month for giving close relationships special attention or when you seek out others for company, feedback, and companionship more than usual. While you're leaving a work-focused phase behind, don't entirely ignore business or career-related news and ideas, as this can be a day for discovering valuable information that can further your professional goals. In fact, you may gain refreshing clarity along these lines now.

Flowing daily routines will ultimately help you achieve your goals, dear Libra, and today is strong for getting things going from the ground up. You're in great shape for business ventures or thinking along financial and business lines today. Your personal appeal is powerful, and a feeling of abundance can figure strongly now. The Moon settles into your health and work sector, and while this transit lasts only a little over two days, it's a fine time of the lunar month to get cracking on duties, chores, work, or health routines. This can be particularly refreshing if you've been putting these things off. You want to be useful or productive now. You'll find it easy for much of the day to tuck away your emotions enough to take care of business. Use your tendency to see flaws in magnification mode today to solve practical problems.

The Moon now pulls you out of your shell, dear Scorpio, as it has moved into your colorful, playful solar fifth house after spending a couple of days in your sector of home, family, nurture, and sustenance. You drop some inhibitions and fears at this point in the lunar cycle, and you're ready to share your unique qualities with others. You quite enjoy increased passion for a project or personal interest now. With Venus in your sign harmonizing with the Moon, you're especially attractive and fascinating. Close relationships can thrive with special attention. Look for reasons to take a healthy escape from serious business, unless serious business is your particular pleasure at the moment!

The Moon is now in your self-protective sector of home and family, dear Sagittarius, and spends the day there, putting you in processing mode! You might quite enjoy some quiet, and planetary energies active now make it easy to go with the flow in many ways, even if schedules aren't always reliable. Past relationships can be on your mind in a mainly pleasant way. This is a time for a hiatus of sorts, whether it's merely about unplugging for a bit or getting extra time to sleep in. Honor your needs for familiarity, comfort, and rest away from the demands and concerns of the outside world when possible now. Your instincts to wait out a situation can be strong and helpful.

Today is strong for bonding with others who share similar goals and visions, dear Capricorn. The Moon has moved into your communications sector, and you're likely to experience an increased need for mental engagement. This cycle is a brief one, only lasting for just over two days, but it's useful for putting your feelers out. Personal matters take center stage, and with your curiosity activated, you're seeking new information or interesting interactions. You're likely to be in a busy but pleasant frame of mind. This can be a powerful and even magical day when it comes to friends, connections, and confidence. It may not run exactly as expected, with the Moon's square to erratic Uranus this morning, but the detours you take as a result can lead to happy surprises or new methods.

Your emotions settle, and the pace relaxes today, dear Aquarius, with the Moon now in your solar second house. You're thinking about what's best for you in the long term, and this helps you make better choices. As well, you might thoroughly enjoy working on a master plan or career project now. This is a good time for a subtle but useful boost to your reputation or professional life. Venus at the top of your solar chart receives support from the Moon today, and you're looking good! You're inclined to make smart moves with business and money. You're less focused on emotional whims and more interested in getting comfortable and settling in today.

There is a fresh feeling to the day, dear Pisces, with the Moon in your sign pulling you out of your shell. This transit can bring a pleasant rush of energy to your life and a desire to begin anew or to enjoy a new experience. Emotions are more transparent than they have been in recent days. You incline to go your own way with this transit, but today is excellent for sharing ideas with others, so be sure to let others in. People around you may not be as reliable as you'd like, and while you're used to shouldering the load, you may feel some frustration. Otherwise, this is a good day to find satisfying outlets for excess energy.
